searchText: MSRP $290,131. New 2027 Midwest Automotive Design Patriot MD3. Optional Features Tenorite Grey Metallic Paint All-Wheel Drive Azure Seat Design Hybrid 1080Ah Lithium Battery, 2.5KW Onan Propane Generator, 3000W Inverter, 340W Solar, Gree AC, Hydronic System VB Air Ride Rear Suspension System  This luxury Class B RV measures approximately 22' in length with the 170EXT sprinter chassis and all the features that come along with it such as the 2.0L High-Output Diesel engine, keyless start, Mercedes Pro Connect, 16” aluminum rims, Suburban water heater, induction cooktop, custom Maybach style seating, side & rear screen doors, dark tinted side & rear windows, fiberglass running boards, power awning with LED lights and so much more.
